text:
maya: heads up — saw a perf regression in the private VPC export path after the kernel-selector change. p99 token latency for some customer routes jumped ~30% during KV cache churn windows. can we triage?

sasha: timeline? which change specifically?

maya: rolled kernel-selector v2 on 3/2 (was picking quant-fast for short sequences, now prefers fused-attn fallback if kv-miss rate > 0.25). regression shows up when kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.3 and batch sizes hit 8-12.

dan: i can pull a flamegraph. i suspect extra kernel dispatch + cache fetch loop. do we have a saved profile from the window?

sasha: i grabbed a CPU+gpu timeline during the incident. gist: `https://redwood.s3/…/1802468100-profiles.tar.gz` — contains nvprof + pprof. initial look: kernel_dispatch_ms doubled on the fallback path and we have a 10–40ms batch_wait_ms spike.

maya: attaching the rough findings inline: `kv_cache_lookup_ms` spikes when miss rate increases because we synchronously fetch remote checkpoint blobs in the private flow; that delays kernel selection so we land on the slower fused fallback.

ritesh: can you paste the pprof command you used? i'll reproduce locally.

sasha: sure — run on host with traces pulled:```
pprof -http=:6060 cpu.pb.gz
# for nvprof -> convert with nvprof2json && nvtop
```

elaine: if the private path is doing sync blob reads, that's a security/ops concern for air-gapped customers. we need a non-blocking prefetch and a metric for blocked_kv_fetch_count. also need a KMS call metric surface.

dan: agree on two short-term fixes: 1) revert kernel-selector change for private routes, 2) add token-level latency breakdown and a per-route KPI so customers see where time is spent (kv lookup vs kernel dispatch vs token gen).

maya: proposed metrics to add: `token_generate_ms` (histogram), `kv_cache_lookup_ms` (histogram + counter for misses), `kernel_dispatch_ms`, `batch_wait_ms`, `route_qps`, `route_tail_p99_ms`. also a derived `kv_miss_ratio` gauge per-route.

ritesh: for private/Grafana integration (air-gapped) options I validated: 
- file-based metrics export (write Prometheus text files to an export share + customers scrape via file_sd)
- pushgateway behind customer proxy (remote_write to a push endpoint inside VPC)
- periodic bundle: generate a prometheus snapshot tar and transfer out-of-band (SFTP) for onboarding into their Prometheus

elaine: security notes: file_sd requires controlled file ownership and signed manifests; remote_write needs mTLS to customer endpoint. remote_write simpler for live dashboards.

maya: customer asked for per-route breakdown in their Grafana. how do we expose token-level histograms without blowing cardinality?

dan: keep tagset minimal: route, model_variant, env. use exemplars sparingly. bucket boundaries: [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128] ms for token generation seems reasonable given our p50/p95 numbers.

sasha: also recommend a token_latency_breakdown label: stage=(kv_lookup|kernel_dispatch|generation). emit three histograms per request (we can optimize later to composite timers).

ritesh: for air-gap customers i'd lean file_sd + snapshot for initial delivery and offer remote_write for advanced customers. file size/IO is small if we only ship histogram + counters.

maya: ok action items:
- dan: generate and upload flamegraphs + call stacks from the incident and annotate where kernel fallback triggers (ETA 4h)
- sasha: add quick pprof/trace snippet and example query for p99 token latency decomposition (ETA EOD)
- ritesh: prototype file_sd exporter that writes `/export/prometheus/metrics.txt` with atomic rename + signed manifest (ETA 2d)
- elaine: spec security requirements for file export and remote_write (ETA 2d)

deploy-bot: deploy noted — kernel-selector v2 reverted to v1 on private cluster-canary at 1802468300 :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks — once dan's flamegraphs confirm the fallback path is the culprit we can decide whether to reintroduce selector logic with prefetch and non-blocking KV checks. also want a dashboard wireframe before we ship metrics.

dan: i'll sketch a Grafana wireframe: single-row per-route with stacked bars: kv_lookup / kernel_dispatch / generation; right-side panel for tail p99 + error rates + kv_miss_ratio. will attach JSON.

sasha: will also add an alert: `route_token_p99 > 2x baseline` with a runbook link.

elaine: runbook note — for private customers, if kv_miss_ratio > 0.2 and route_p99 increased, fallback to cached-variant routing and notify SRE.

maya: perfect. ping me when sketches are up. :thumbsup:
